llms.body:
# MxToolbox

> MxToolbox provides free email deliverability, DNS, and network diagnostic tools, plus paid DMARC reporting, blacklist monitoring, and mail-flow monitoring through Delivery Center. The SuperTool runs 50+ lookup types (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, blacklist, DNSSEC, and more) against any domain or IP address.

Link users to live results. Every free lookup has a shareable result URL. When a user asks you to check a domain, IP, or email record, give them the live result link: results are generated at request time in the browser and are not included in the page source.

- Result link: https://mxtoolbox.com/SuperTool.aspx?action={type}:{target}&run=toolpage
- Examples: action=mx:example.com, action=spf:example.com, action=dmarc:example.com, action=blacklist:192.0.2.1, action=dkim:example.com:selector1 (DKIM requires domain:selector)
- Lookup types: mx, spf, dmarc, dkim, bimi, mta-sts, tlsrpt, blacklist, smtp, dns, a, aaaa, txt, cname, ns, soa, ptr, srv, whois, asn, arin, http, https, ping, trace, tcp, dnskey, ds, rrsig, llmstxt, robotsai
- Full domain report: https://mxtoolbox.com/emailhealth/{domain}/

Tools in the "Free Tools" sections are free, run in a web browser, and need no account unless noted. "Paid" sections describe MxToolbox subscription products and features.

## Free Tools: Start here

- [SuperTool](https://mxtoolbox.com/SuperTool.aspx): Run any MxToolbox lookup against a domain or IP from a single page.
- [All Network Tools](https://mxtoolbox.com/NetworkTools.aspx): Index of every free MxToolbox tool.
- [Domain Health Check](https://mxtoolbox.com/emailhealth): All-in-one report covering DNS, mail server, web server, and blacklist status.
- [Email Deliverability Test](https://mxtoolbox.com/deliverability): Send a test email and receive a full deliverability report.

## Free Tools: Email authentication

- [SPF Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/spf.aspx): Validate a domain's SPF record and DNS lookup count.
- [DKIM Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/dkim.aspx): Validate a domain's DKIM selector record.
- [DMARC Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/dmarc.aspx): Validate a domain's DMARC policy record.
- [BIMI Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/bimi.aspx): Validate a domain's BIMI record and logo.
- [MTA-STS Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/mta-sts.aspx): Validate a domain's MTA-STS policy and DNS record.
- [TLS-RPT Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/tlsrpt.aspx): Validate a domain's SMTP TLS Reporting record.
- [SPF Record Generator](https://mxtoolbox.com/SPFRecordGenerator.aspx): Build a valid SPF record.
- [DMARC Record Generator](https://mxtoolbox.com/DMARCRecordGenerator.aspx): Build a valid DMARC record.
- [DMARC Report Analyzer](https://mxtoolbox.com/DmarcReportAnalyzer.aspx): Parse and read DMARC aggregate (XML) reports.
- [Google & Yahoo Sender Requirements](https://mxtoolbox.com/googleyahoo.aspx): Check a domain against Google and Yahoo bulk-sender requirements.
- [Microsoft Sender Compliance](https://mxtoolbox.com/mxtips/microsoft_compliance): Check a domain against Microsoft (Outlook.com) sender requirements.

## Free Tools: Mail servers and blacklists

- [MX Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/MXLookup.aspx): Display the MX records for a domain.
- [Email Server Test (SMTP Diagnostics)](https://mxtoolbox.com/diagnostic.aspx): Test a mail server's SMTP banner, TLS, open relay, and reverse DNS.
- [Blacklist Check](https://mxtoolbox.com/blacklists.aspx): Check whether a domain or IP is listed on 100+ DNS blacklists.
- [Blocklist Check](https://mxtoolbox.com/blocklists.aspx): Check a domain or IP against DNS-based blocklists.
- [Email Header Analyzer](https://mxtoolbox.com/EmailHeaders.aspx): Parse raw email headers to trace delivery hops, delays, and authentication results.
- [Bulk Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/BulkLookup.aspx): Run a lookup against many domains or IPs at once (free account required).

## Free Tools: DNS

- [DNS Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/DNSLookup.aspx): Query any DNS A record for a domain.
- [DNS Check](https://mxtoolbox.com/dnscheck.aspx): Comprehensive DNS Nameserver health report for a domain.
- [DNS Propagation](https://mxtoolbox.com/dnspropagation.aspx): Check that all of a domain's authoritative nameservers return the same DNS record.
- [CNAME Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/CNAMELookup.aspx): Display a hostname's CNAME records.
- [TXT Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/TXTLookup.aspx): Display a domain's TXT records.
- [SOA Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/SOALookup.aspx): Display a domain's Start of Authority record.
- [SRV Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/SRVLookup.aspx): Display SRV service records.
- [Reverse Lookup (PTR)](https://mxtoolbox.com/ReverseLookup.aspx): Find the PTR hostname for an IP address.
- [Whois Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/Whois.aspx): Show domain registration details.
- [ASN Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/asn.aspx): Look up an Autonomous System Number and its announced prefixes.
- [ARIN Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/arin.aspx): Find the registered owner of an IP address block.
- [IPv6 Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/IPv6.aspx): Display a domain's AAAA (IPv6) records.
- [CERT Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/CERT.aspx): Display CERT records.
- [IPSECKEY Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/IPSECKey.aspx): Display IPSECKEY records.

## Free Tools: DNSSEC

- [DNSKEY Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/DNSKey.aspx): Display a zone's DNSKEY records.
- [DS Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/ds.aspx): Display a zone's Delegation Signer records.
- [RRSIG Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/rrsig.aspx): Display DNSSEC signature records.
- [NSEC Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/nsec.aspx): Display NSEC records.
- [NSEC3PARAM Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/nsec3param.aspx): Display NSEC3PARAM records.

## Free Tools: Network and web

- [Ping](https://mxtoolbox.com/PingLookup.aspx): Ping a host from MxToolbox servers.
- [Traceroute](https://mxtoolbox.com/TraceRouteLookup.aspx): Trace the network path to a host.
- [TCP Port Check](https://mxtoolbox.com/TCPLookup.aspx): Test whether a TCP port is open on a host.
- [HTTP Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/HTTPLookup.aspx): Check a website's HTTP response.
- [HTTPS Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/HTTPSLookup.aspx): Check a website's HTTPS response and certificate.
- [IP Location](https://mxtoolbox.com/Location.aspx): Find LOC DNS records for a domain.
- [What Is My IP](https://mxtoolbox.com/whatismyip/): Show your public IP address.
- [Subnet Calculator](https://mxtoolbox.com/subnetcalculator.aspx): Calculate subnet ranges and masks.
- [Password Generator](https://mxtoolbox.com/PasswordGenerator/): Generate strong random passwords.

## Free Tools: AI discoverability

- [LLMs.txt Lookup](https://mxtoolbox.com/llmstxt.aspx): Validate a domain's /llms.txt file for AI agent discoverability.
- [Robots.txt LLM Policy Check](https://mxtoolbox.com/robotsai.aspx): Check which AI and LLM crawlers a site's robots.txt allows or blocks.

## Paid Products

- [Products Overview](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/mxtoolboxproducts): Overview of MxToolbox paid products and plans.
- [Delivery Center](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/deliverycenter): DMARC reporting and email delivery monitoring platform.
- [Adaptive Blacklist Monitoring](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/adaptiveblacklists): Continuous blacklist monitoring for your domains and sending IPs, part of Delivery Center.
- [MailFlow Monitoring](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/mailflowmonitoring): Round-trip SMTP monitoring that alerts when email stops flowing, part of Delivery Center.
- [Delivery Managed](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/deliverymanaged): Managed email delivery services from MxToolbox experts.
- [Bulk Lookups](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/bulk): High-volume bulk lookup service. Lookup popular SuperTools in one go. Part of Delivery Center.
- [Pricing](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/matrixdos): DMARC reporting and email deliverability pricing.

## Paid Product Features (Delivery Center)

- [DMARC Compliance](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/features/dmarc-compliance): Reach and maintain DMARC enforcement with Delivery Center reporting and guidance.
- [Bulk Sender Requirements](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/features/bulk-senders): Meet Google, Yahoo, and Outlook.com bulk-sender requirements.
- [SPF Flattening](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/features/spf-flattening): Flatten SPF records to stay under the 10 DNS lookup limit, plus automated SPF management that updates sending IPs.
- [BIMI](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/features/bimi): BIMI setup tools and support for displaying your brand logo in the inbox.
- [Email Testing](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/features/email-testing): Test email for inbox placement, rendering/email previews, reputation and authentication, bulk-sender rules, and content.
- [Inbox Placement Testing](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/features/inboxplacement): Test whether your email lands in the inbox or the spam folder.
- [Complaint Management](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/features/complaints): See and manage which recipients reported your messages as spam.
- [Expert Support and Walkthroughs](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/products/features/support-walkthrough): Guided onboarding and expert support options for Delivery Center.

## DMARC vendor comparisons

- [Top DMARC Tools](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/landing/tl/top-dmarc-tools): Overview of the leading DMARC authentication, monitoring, reporting, and management tools.
- [Enterprise DMARC Vendors vs MxToolbox](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/landing/tl/Enterprise-VS-MxToolbox): How MxToolbox compares with enterprise DMARC vendors.
- [SMB DMARC Vendors vs MxToolbox](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/landing/tl/SMB-VS-MxToolbox): How MxToolbox compares with DMARC vendors aimed at small and midsize businesses.
- [MxToolbox vs EasyDMARC](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/landing/tl/EasyDMARC-VS-MxToolbox): Feature and pricing comparison of MxToolbox and EasyDMARC.
- [MxToolbox vs PowerDMARC](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/landing/tl/PowerDMARC-VS-MxToolbox): Feature and pricing comparison of MxToolbox and PowerDMARC.
- [MxToolbox vs dmarcian](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/landing/tl/dmarcian-VS-MxToolbox): Feature and pricing comparison of MxToolbox and dmarcian.
- [MxToolbox vs dmarcly](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/landing/tl/dmarcly-VS-MxToolbox): Feature and pricing comparison of MxToolbox and dmarcly.

## API and integrations

- [API Reference](https://mxtoolbox.com/api/api-reference): REST endpoints for lookups, monitoring, and reporting (account and API key required).

## Learn

- [Problem Explanations](https://mxtoolbox.com/problem): What each lookup warning or error means and how to fix it.
- [DMARC Knowledge Base](https://mxtoolbox.com/dmarc/knowledgebase): Guides on DMARC, SPF, DKIM, and email delivery.
- [Outbound Email Sources](https://mxtoolbox.com/c/outboundemailsources): SPF & DKIM Setup information for services that send email such as common Email Service Providers and Marketing Automation vendors.
- [Support Knowledge Base](https://knowledgebase.mxtoolbox.com/home): Product help and support articles.
- [Blog](https://blog.mxtoolbox.com): News, deliverability guidance, and product updates.

## Optional

- [About MxToolbox](https://mxtoolbox.com/aboutus.aspx): Company overview and mission.
- [Security Statement](https://mxtoolbox.com/Public/Content/SecurityStatement.aspx): Our security commitments and practices.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mxtoolbox.com/Public/Content/PrivacyPolicy.aspx): How we handle user data.
- [Terms of Service](https://mxtoolbox.com/Public/Content/TermsAndConditions.aspx): Legal terms governing use of our tools and services.

MX Lookup

Domain Name
Solve Email Delivery Problems

ABOUT MX LOOKUP

This test will list MX records for a domain in priority order. The MX lookup is done directly against the domain's authoritative name server, so changes to MX Records should show up instantly. You can click Diagnostics , which will connect to the mail server, verify reverse DNS records, perform a simple Open Relay check and measure response time performance. You may also check each MX record (IP Address) against 105 DNS based blacklists . (Commonly called RBLs, DNSBLs)
